trails.name: 남파랑길 3코스
trails.ko: 송도해상케이블카·송도해수욕장에서 암남공원, 감천항까지 이어지는 부산 대표 해안 명소길
trails.en: Links the Songdo Marine Cable Car and Songdo Beach with Amnam Park and Gamcheon Port, along a coastline that earned Busan the nickname 'Naples of the East'. Includes part of Busan's Galmaetgil Route 4-1.

trails.name: 남파랑길 4코스
trails.ko: 몰운대·다대포해변공원·아미산전망대를 잇는 국가지질공원 해안길, 기암괴석과 해송숲이 일품
trails.en: Passes Molundae, Dadaepo Beach Park and Amisan Observatory, a famous sunset spot, through Busan's National Geopark with its rock formations and pine forest. Also winds through the fishing-village lanes of Dadaepo Port.

trails.name: 남파랑길 9코스
trails.ko: 진해드림로드에서 마산항까지, 문신미술관·가고파 꼬부랑 벽화마을 등 마산 원도심을 걷는 길
trails.en: Runs from the Jinhae Dream Road to Masan Port through forest, city and coastal paths, passing Chusan Park, the Moonshin Art Museum, Changwon City Masan Museum and the Gagopa Kkoburang mural village. Finishes along the Imhangseon Greenway.

trails.name: 남파랑길 15코스
trails.ko: 신거제대교에서 바라보는 해안 풍경이 아름다운, 통영과 거제를 잇는 남파랑길 통영 마지막 구간
trails.en: Connects Tongyeong and Geoje, with especially fine city and coastal views from the New Geoje Bridge. A mountain path gives way to seaside villages on this last Tongyeong section of the Namparang-gil.

trails.name: 남파랑길 16코스
trails.ko: 한려해상국립공원 해안과 대형 조선소, 작은 어촌마을이 어우러진 거제만의 독특한 풍경길
trails.en: The Geoje leg of the 'Hallyeo-gil', with coastal scenery of Hallyeohaesang National Park. Huge shipyards beside small fishing villages give Geoje its distinctive look, and both ends are easy to reach by transport.

trails.name: 남파랑길 18코스
trails.ko: 두모 몽돌해수욕장·흥남해수욕장·외포항·김영삼 전 대통령 생가를 둘러보는 해안길
trails.en: Takes in Dumo Pebble Beach, Heungnam Beach, Oepo Port and the birthplace of former President Kim Young-sam along a scenic stretch of coast.

trails.name: 남파랑길 19코스
trails.ko: 김영삼 대통령 생가에서 장승포까지, 덕포해수욕장·옥포대첩기념관을 지나는 초보자용 바닷길
trails.en: Runs from President Kim Young-sam's birthplace to Jangseungpo, including the 'Road to Meet Admiral Yi Sun-sin' on Geoje's Island & Island Trail. Easy for beginners, with Deokpo Beach, the Okpo Great Victory Memorial Hall and seaside boardwalks.

trails.name: 남파랑길 20코스
trails.ko: 양지암등대길 일부를 품은, 해안데크와 공원길 따라 한려해상 풍경을 즐기는 거제 바닷길
trails.en: Includes part of the Yangjiam Lighthouse Trail on Geoje's Island & Island Trail, with well-kept park paths, seaside decks and views of the Hallyeohaesang coast.

trails.name: 남파랑길 28코스
trails.ko: 세자트라숲·이순신공원을 지나 남망산조각공원 입구까지, 토영이야기길과 만나는 편안한 해안길
trails.en: Leads past Tongyeong's Sejatra Forest and Yi Sun-sin Park, with lovely sea views, to the entrance of Nammangsan Sculpture Park. Joins the Toyeong Iyagi-gil, Tongyeong's signature walking trail.

trails.name: 남파랑길 34코스
trails.ko: 남일대해수욕장에서 노산공원, 삼천포항 수산시장까지 볼거리·먹거리 가득한 코끼리길
trails.en: Follows the Samcheonpo Elephant Trail of Sacheon's 'Yi Sun-sin Sea Road', from Namildae Beach past Samcheonpo New Port and Nosan Park to the Samcheonpo fish market. Plenty to see and eat along the lively harbour.

trails.name: 남파랑길 35코스
trails.ko: 실안노을길 조망이 유명한, 산과 바다를 고루 즐기는 한려해상 이순신 바닷길
trails.en: Covers the First Turtle Ship Trail and part of the Silan Sunset Trail of the 'Yi Sun-sin Sea Road', famed for its views. A mix of mountain and sea in Hallyeohaesang National Park.

trails.name: 남파랑길 36코스
trails.ko: 삼천포대교·늑도대교·창선대교를 건너 남해로 들어가고, 편백숲 임도에서 동대만을 조망하는 길
trails.en: Crosses the Samcheonpo, Neukdo and Changseon bridges from Sacheon to Changseon in Namhae, with sea views all the way. A long cypress-forest road overlooks Dongdaeman Bay and Gonyu Village.

trails.name: 남파랑길 42코스
trails.ko: 파도 소리가 앵무새를 닮은 앵강만을 따라, 꽃무릇 군락 앵강다숲길을 걷는 인기 구간
trails.en: Follows curving Aenggang Bay from Woncheon Village; its name comes from waves said to sound like parrots. Passes the Aenggang Dasup-gil, known for red spider lilies, and village lanes above the bay.

trails.name: 남파랑길 44코스
trails.ko: 평산항에서 임진왜란 때 쌓은 임진성과 천황산 숲길을 지나 노을 고운 남해스포츠파크까지
trails.en: Heads from Pyeongsan Port through farm lanes and forest to Imjinseong Fortress, built during the Imjin War, then along the scenic Cheonhwangsan forest trail. Ends at Namhae Sports Park, known for its sunsets.

trails.name: 남파랑길 46코스
trails.ko: 400여 년 전 이순신 장군 운구행렬이 지난 길, 목가적인 마을길과 숲길을 걷는 구간
trails.en: Traces the route of Admiral Yi Sun-sin's funeral procession over 400 years ago. A pastoral walk on village lanes and forest paths set back from the sea.

trails.name: 남파랑길 48코스
trails.ko: 영호남을 잇는 섬진교에서 출발해 매화·벚꽃 흐드러진 섬진강 강변을 걷는 길
trails.en: Starts at Seomjingyo Bridge, which links the Gyeongsang and Jeolla regions, and follows the banks of the Seomjingang River. Especially beautiful in spring with plum and cherry blossoms.

trails.name: 남파랑길 49코스
trails.ko: 망덕포구와 윤동주 유고를 지킨 정병욱 가옥을 지나 광양제철소를 따라 걷는 길
trails.en: Passes Mangdeok Harbour and runs alongside the Gwangyang Steelworks, mixing industry, nature and culture. On the way is the Jeong Byeong-uk House, where poet Yun Dong-ju's manuscripts were kept.

trails.name: 남파랑길 51코스
trails.ko: 광양에서 순천왜성과 하천변 산책로를 지나 여수 율촌까지 이어지는 농촌 풍경길
trails.en: Runs from Gwangyang through Haeryong-myeon in Suncheon to Yulchon-myeon in Yeosu across classic farm country, on riverside trails past the Suncheon Japanese Castle.

trails.name: 남파랑길 54코스
trails.ko: 여수엑스포공원·자산공원·오동도·하멜등대 등 여수 해양관광지를 잇는 도심 바닷길
trails.en: Runs from Yeosu Bus Terminal to Yeosu Marine Park, close to Expo Park, Jasan Park, Odongdo Island, the Hamel Memorial Hall and Hamel Lighthouse.

trails.name: 남파랑길 55코스
trails.ko: 이순신광장·고소동 벽화마을·웅천해변·소호동동다리까지 볼거리·먹거리 풍성한 여수 해안길
trails.en: Links Yeosu Marine Park to Soho Yacht Marina via Yi Sun-sin Square, Gosodong 1004 Mural Village, Yeosu and Gukdong ports, Ungcheon Beach, the Seonso historic site and Sohodongdong Bridge. Plenty to see and eat.

trails.name: 남파랑길 59코스
trails.ko: 여자만 풍광을 바라보며 리아스식 해안의 한적한 어촌마을을 지나는 길
trails.en: Follows farm roads and bike paths from Changmu to Gunghang Village with lovely views over Yeojaman Bay, past quiet fishing villages on a ria coastline.

trails.name: 남파랑길 61코스
trails.ko: 와온해변에서 순천만 갈대길을 따라, 용산전망대 일몰이 아름다운 순천만습지 구간
trails.en: Goes from Waon Beach to Byeollyang Hwapo along the Suncheon Bay reed trail, mostly on safe dirt tracks and bike paths. Yongsan Observatory in Suncheon Bay Wetland offers a famous sunset view.

trails.name: 남파랑길 64코스
trails.ko: 팔영산과 백일도·진지도를 조망하며 농로와 작은 포구를 지나는 소박한 농촌길
trails.en: Crosses coastal farmland from Boseong into Goheung, with views of Palyeongsan, one of Korea's 100 famous mountains, and the islands of Baegildo and Jinjido. Few sights, but a real look at rural life through small villages and harbours.

trails.name: 남파랑길 66코스
trails.ko: 용암·우암전망대, 우주발사전망대, 다랭이논을 지나며 다도해를 조망하는 미르마루길
trails.en: Includes Goheung's Mireumaru-gil, passing Yongam and Uam observatories, the Thousand-Year Trail, the Space Launch Observatory and terraced rice paddies. Forest roads on Umisan look out over the Dadohae islands.

trails.name: 남파랑길 69코스
trails.ko: 천등산 임도를 따라 완만하게 걸으며 해안 절경을 내려다보는 쾌적한 숲길
trails.en: Crosses the Cheondeungsan area, taking in parts of the Ssamok-ssamok-gil and Cheondeungsan Meonnamu-gil. Gentle forest roads with superb coastal views from the mountain.

trails.name: 남파랑길 81코스
trails.ko: 마량항에서 가우도 입구까지 바다둘레길 따라 내내 해안 절경을 즐기는 길
trails.en: Follows Gangjin's Sea Loop Trail from Maryang Port to the entrance of Gaudo Island, a rising local attraction, with coastal views the whole way.

trails.name: 남파랑길 83코스
trails.ko: 강진만생태공원·백련사·다산초당·석문공원을 잇는, 정약용 남도유배길이 포함된 구간
trails.en: Links Gangjin Bay Eco Park, Baengnyeonsa Temple, Dasan Chodang and Seongmun Park, Gangjin's key sights. Includes Jeong Yak-yong's Namdo Exile Trail and the Gangjin Baseurak-gil.

trails.name: 남파랑길 85코스
trails.ko: 사내방조제를 지나 두륜산과 남해 바다를 조망하는 해남 삼남길 해안 구간
trails.en: Passes the Sanae Seawall and follows the coast with views of Duryunsan Mountain and the south sea, including part of the Haenam Samnam-gil. You can skip the Wando section and continue straight to the next Haenam course.

trails.name: 남파랑길 86코스
trails.ko: 완도대교를 건너 청해진 유적지·장보고기념관·전복거리를 지나 완도항에 이르는 길
trails.en: Crosses Wando Bridge from Haenam to Wando Port, taking in the Cheonghaejin site, Jang Bogo Park and the Jang Bogo Memorial Hall. Also passes the Wando Marine Ecology Exhibition Hall and Abalone Street, with views of Dalmasan.

trails.name: 남파랑길 87코스
trails.ko: 완도항에서 완도타워·자갈해변을 지나 청해포구 촬영장까지 이어지는 남해안 해안길
trails.en: Goes from Wando Port past Dadohae Sunrise Park, Wando Tower and pebble beaches to the Cheonghae Harbour film set, on forest, village and coastal paths along Wando's south shore.

trails.name: 서해랑길 101코스
trails.ko: 강화의 마을과 논밭을 거닐며 곳곳에 숨은 고려시대 역사와 문화를 찾는 길
trails.en: Wanders Ganghwa's villages and rice fields, seeking out hidden traces of Goryeo-era history and culture.

trails.name: 서해랑길 38코스
trails.ko: 서해 바닷바람을 품은 풍력발전단지를 지나는 길
trails.en: Passes a wind farm powered by the West Sea breeze.

trails.name: 서해랑길 20코스
trails.ko: 시골길과 들길을 지나 넓은 백사장과 해송숲이 어우러진 톱머리해변으로 가는 길
trails.en: Country lanes and field paths lead to Topmeori Beach, with its wide sands and coastal pine forest.

trails.name: 서해랑길 3코스
trails.ko: 울창한 갈대숲과 새떼, 오랜 갯벌을 지나 돌담 예쁜 마을길을 걷는 길
trails.en: Passes dense reed beds with soaring birds, then ancient tidal flats and a village of pretty stone walls.

trails.name: 서해랑길 52코스
trails.ko: 만경강과 탁 트인 김제평야를 따라 백제 역사와 서해 낙조를 만나는 길
trails.en: Follows the Mangyeonggang River across the wide-open Gimje Plain, with Baekje history and West Sea sunsets.

trails.name: 서해랑길 64-4(지선4코스)
trails.ko: 아름다운 땅 내포의 역사와 근대건축의 미를 탐방하는 길
trails.en: Explores the history and modern architecture of the Naepo region.

trails.name: 서해랑길 26코스
trails.ko: 지도에서 솔섬·사옥도로 이어지는 다리를 건너며 갯벌과 해변을 바라보는 섬길
trails.en: Crosses the bridges linking Jido with Solseom and Saokdo, passing through three islands. Quiet village lanes with views of tidal flats and beaches.

trails.name: 서해랑길 67코스
trails.ko: 송림과 기암괴석이 어우러진 해변과 어촌 풍경을 두루 보는 해안길
trails.en: Coastal pine groves and striking rock formations line the beaches and fishing villages along this shore.

trails.name: 서해랑길 69코스
trails.ko: 희귀식물 가득한 천리포식물원과 서해의 절경 해변이 이어지는 길
trails.en: Passes Chollipo Arboretum, home to many tree species and rare plants, followed by a string of beautiful West Sea beaches.

trails.name: 서해랑길 70코스
trails.ko: 천연기념물이 사는 생태습지와 오랜 세월이 빚은 해안사구를 만나는 길
trails.en: Visits an ecological wetland home to protected wildlife and coastal sand dunes formed over tens of millions of years.

trails.name: 서해랑길 71코스
trails.ko: 바위와 섬, 송림 실루엣이 어우러진 노을 명소와 체험 가득한 농어촌 마을길
trails.en: A sunset hotspot where rocks, islets, beaches and pine silhouettes meet, plus farming and fishing villages with hands-on activities.

trails.name: 서해랑길 72코스
trails.ko: 작고 예쁜 해변과 조용한 숲길에서 시원한 바닷바람을 즐기는 길
trails.en: Small, pretty beaches and quiet forest trails with cool sea breezes.

trails.name: 서해랑길 73코스
trails.ko: 만대항에서 바다가 보이는 후망산 임도를 지나 어촌 마을길·숲길을 걷는 길
trails.en: Starts at Mandae Port and crosses Humangsan on a quiet forest road with sea views, mixing village, forest and coastal paths.

trails.name: 서해랑길 60코스
trails.ko: 해산물 집산지 대천항과 머드축제로 유명한 대천해변에서 싱싱한 해산물을 맛보는 길
trails.en: Passes Daecheon Port, a West Sea seafood hub and ferry gateway to nearby islands, and Daecheon Beach, home of the world-famous mud festival, where fresh seafood awaits.

trails.name: 서해랑길 62코스
trails.ko: 싱싱한 굴과 해산물을 맛보고, 역사 깃든 마을과 저수지를 지나는 내륙길
trails.en: A chance to taste West Sea seafood and fresh oysters, then an inland walk past historic villages and a reservoir.

trails.name: 서해랑길 81코스
trails.ko: 간척지를 개간해 식량 증산을 꾀한 개발 현장을 마주하는 길
trails.en: Passes reclaimed land that was turned into farmland to boost food production.

trails.name: 서해랑길 88코스
trails.ko: 하루 두 번 열리는 제부도 바닷길과 갯벌 위 낙조를 감상하는 길
trails.en: Faces the sea road to Jebudo Island, which opens twice a day, with beautiful sunsets over the tidal flats.

trails.name: 서해랑길 90코스
trails.ko: 청정 갯벌과 바위섬 너머로 지는 아름다운 일몰을 감상하는 길
trails.en: Clean tidal flats and beautiful sunsets that sink behind rocky islets.

trails.name: 서해랑길 91코스
trails.ko: 대부해솔길 구간으로 낙조가 일품이며 조개구이와 너른 갯벌을 즐기는 섬마을길
trails.en: Part of the Daebu Haesol-gil, with superb sunsets over the sea. Island villages offer activities, grilled clams and wide tidal flats.

trails.name: 서해랑길 64-3(지선3코스)
trails.ko: 삼국시대 문화와 건축의 숨결을 만나고 숲길과 봄꽃을 즐기는 역사기행길
trails.en: A history walk through Three Kingdoms-era culture and architecture, with fresh forest trails and spring flowers along the way.

trails.name: 서해랑길 64-5(지선5코스)
trails.ko: 천주교의 아픈 역사가 어린 순례길을 따라 고즈넉한 숲길을 걷는 길
trails.en: Follows a Catholic pilgrimage path steeped in painful history, through quiet, dense forest.

trails.name: 서해랑길 12코스
trails.ko: 파도 소리와 서해 낙조, 백조가 노니는 호수를 즐기는 길
trails.en: Walk to the sound of waves under blue skies, with West Sea sunsets and a lake where swans gather.

trails.name: 서해랑길 55코스
trails.ko: 근대역사거리에서 일제강점기 역사를 만나고 추억의 영화 촬영지를 걷는 길
trails.en: Walks Gunsan's modern history streets, bringing the Japanese colonial era vividly to life, and nostalgic old film locations.

trails.name: 서해랑길 56코스
trails.ko: 금강하구 장항항과 산림욕장을 지나며 풍성한 해산물을 맛보는 서해안 길
trails.en: Follows the West Sea coast past Janghang Port, where the Geumgang River meets the sea, and a forest bathing area. Good for fresh seafood.

trails.name: 서해랑길 57코스
trails.ko: 해변길을 걸으며 어촌마을과 바닷가 풍경을 두루 보는 길
trails.en: A beach walk taking in fishing villages and coastal scenery.

trails.name: 서해랑길 58코스
trails.ko: 비인해변에서 춘장대해변까지 서해 해변과 마을을 감상하는 길
trails.en: Runs from Biin Beach to Chunjangdae Beach past West Sea beaches and villages.

trails.name: 서해랑길 87코스
trails.ko: 옛 미 공군 폭격장의 흔적과 어촌·농촌·산업단지를 두루 보는 바닷길
trails.en: Traces of a former US Air Force bombing range recall a painful chapter of history, alongside fishing villages, farms and industrial parks by the sea.

trails.name: 서해랑길 18코스
trails.ko: 근대역사의 흔적과 항구도시 목포의 해넘이, 전설 깃든 산길을 걷는 길
trails.en: A history and culture walk spanning the Joseon era, the Japanese colonial period and today, with fiery sunsets over the port city of Mokpo. Also climbs rocky, wooded hill paths full of old legends.

trails.name: 서해랑길 24코스
trails.ko: 해송숲과 긴 백사장, 갯벌체험을 즐기며 대부분 바다를 보며 걷는 길
trails.en: Beach walks under dense coastal pines along long sands, plus village and field paths. The sea is in view most of the way, with tidal-flat activities.

trails.name: 서해랑길 27코스
trails.ko: 국내 최대 염전인 태평염전과 청정 바다, 갯벌을 보며 걷는 길
trails.en: Walks beside Taepyeong Salt Farm, Korea's largest, made by wind and sun amid clean sea and tidal flats.

trails.name: 서해랑길 28코스
trails.ko: 공해 없는 자연을 인정받아 아시아 최초 슬로시티가 된 증도를 걷는 길
trails.en: Walks through Jeungdo, recognised for its unpolluted nature as Asia's first Slow City.

trails.name: 서해랑길 29코스
trails.ko: 자연이 보존된 증도의 갯벌과 염전, 세 섬을 잇는 다리를 건너는 길
trails.en: Tidal flats and vast salt fields on unspoiled Jeungdo, crossing the bridges that now join three islands to the mainland.

trails.name: 서해랑길 34코스
trails.ko: 함평만 깊숙한 마을들을 잇고 종점 무렵 서해 갯벌 해변길을 걷는 길
trails.en: Links villages around Hampyeong Bay, which cuts deep between Hampyeong and Muan. Near the end a beach path opens onto the West Sea and tidal flats.

trails.name: 서해랑길 36코스
trails.ko: 칠산타워에서 설도항을 지나 해변 따라 농어촌 풍경을 두루 보는 길
trails.en: Goes from Chilsan Tower past Seoldo Port along the beach, taking in both farming and fishing villages.

trails.name: 서해랑길 47코스
trails.ko: 변산반도의 해안 절벽과 적벽강·채석강 등 부안 대표 명소를 지나는 길
trails.en: Faces the cliffs of the Byeonsan Peninsula, shaped over tens of millions of years, passing Buan's famous Jeokbyeokgang and Chaeseokgang.

trails.name: 서해랑길 48코스
trails.ko: 부안 앞바다 노을과 새만금간척사업의 시작, 새만금방조제를 보며 걷는 길
trails.en: Sunsets that paint the Buan sea red, with views of the Saemangeum Seawall, the start of the huge Saemangeum reclamation project.

trails.name: 서해랑길 50코스
trails.ko: 부안과 김제 경계로 향하며 항일 시인의 문학과 내륙 마을 풍경을 만나는 길
trails.en: Heads toward the Buan–Gimje border, with the literature of an anti-Japanese resistance poet and inland village scenery.

trails.name: 서해랑길 16코스
trails.ko: 대표 철새도래지 영암호를 따라 멸종위기 야생동식물을 관찰하는 수변길
trails.en: Follows Yeongamho Lake, one of Korea's main migratory-bird sites, on a waterside path where endangered species can be spotted.

trails.name: 서해랑길 43코스
trails.ko: 생물다양성 풍부한 습지보호지역을 지나 숲길·마을길·갯벌 바닷길을 걷는 길
trails.en: Passes a protected wetland at an open estuary rich in biodiversity, including endangered species, then forest, village and tidal-flat paths.

trails.name: 서해랑길 76코스
trails.ko: 생태계의 보고 가로림만 갯벌체험장을 지나는 어촌·갯벌·숲길 생태탐방로
trails.en: An eco-trail past a tidal-flat experience site on Garorim Bay, a treasure trove of wildlife, via fishing villages, mudflats and forest.

trails.name: 서해랑길 85코스
trails.ko: 평택호의 맑은 물에 깃든 역사와 문화를 만나는 길
trails.en: Explores the history and culture around the clear waters of Pyeongtaek Lake.

trails.name: 서해랑길 92코스
trails.ko: 시화방조제를 걸어 먹거리 풍성한 오이도까지, 전망대와 박물관도 즐기는 길
trails.en: Walks the Sihwa Seawall, a famous Ansan driving route, to Oido at its end, known for its food. Observatories, museums and places to eat keep visitors coming.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 1코스
trails.ko: 강화평화전망대에서 연미정을 지나 문수산성 남문까지, 북한을 조망하는 해안길
trails.en: Runs from Ganghwa Peace Observatory past Yeonmijeong Pavilion to the south gate of Munsusanseong Fortress in Gimpo, along Ganghwa's northeast shore with views of the neutral Han River estuary and North Korea. Joseon-era defence sites line the way.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 3-1코스(우회로)
trails.ko: 통진성당에서 통진읍내와 농로를 지나 한강하구 전류리포구까지 가는 길
trails.en: Runs from Tongjin Catholic Church through Tongjin town and along farm roads to Jeollyu-ri Harbour on the Han River estuary.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 4코스
trails.ko: 전류리포구에서 한강야생조류생태공원을 지나 일산대교 건너 고양으로 가는 길
trails.en: Goes from Jeollyu-ri Harbour to Goyang Stadium, linking the Hadongcheon eco-trail and Han River Wild Bird Ecological Park. Crosses Ilsan Bridge, overlooking the Han River estuary, into Goyang.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 4-1코스(지선코스)
trails.ko: 행주산성에서 장항습지와 한강 군 철책길을 지나 고양종합운동장까지
trails.en: A Goyang theme route from Haengjusanseong Fortress to Goyang Stadium, taking in Janghang Wetland and the military fence path along the lower Han River.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 5코스
trails.ko: 고양종합운동장에서 철새도래지와 파주출판도시를 지나 통일동산까지 걷는 길
trails.en: Goes from Goyang Stadium to Paju's Tongil Park past migratory-bird habitat and border fences on the Han River estuary, then via Paju Book City on country roads.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 7코스
trails.ko: 반구정에서 쉬어 가며 대표 평화관광지 임진각에 이르는 길
trails.en: Runs from Nakha IC to Imjingak, a landmark of peace tourism, with a rest at Bangujeong, a pavilion said to have been built by Hwang Hui.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 8코스 (예약노선)
trails.ko: 사전예약으로 민통선 안을 걷는 길, 봄 유채와 가을 코스모스가 반기는 구간
trails.en: Enters the Civilian Control Zone from Imjingak to Yulgok Wetland Park (advance booking required). Lined with canola flowers in spring and cosmos in autumn.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 9코스
trails.ko: 율곡습지공원에서 조용한 마을과 임진강 철책길을 따라 리비교 거점센터까지
trails.en: Goes from Yulgok Wetland Park to the Ribi Bridge base centre through quiet villages and farm roads, with border fences along the Imjingang River.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 10코스
trails.ko: 리비교에서 장남교까지 파주·연천 경계를 넘는 한적한 시골길
trails.en: Runs from the Ribi Bridge base centre to Jangnamgyo Bridge in Wondang-ri, crossing the Paju–Yeoncheon border on quiet country roads.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 11코스
trails.ko: 사미천과 연천평야를 지나 고인돌부터 숭의전지까지 이어지는 역사탐방길
trails.en: Goes from Jangnamgyo Bridge to the Sunguijeon shrine site, overlooking the Samicheon Stream and Yeoncheon Plain. A history walk from prehistoric dolmens to a Joseon-era shrine.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 16코스 (예약노선)
trails.ko: DMZ두루미평화타운에서 도창리까지, 겨울 철새를 만나는 예약제 민통선 길
trails.en: Runs from DMZ Crane Peace Town to the Dochang-ri checkpoint; part lies inside the Civilian Control Zone, so booking is required. A pristine area where many winter migratory birds can be seen.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 18코스
trails.ko: DMZ 접경 마을과 화강 풍경을 따라 최전방 사람들의 삶을 엿보는 길
trails.en: Goes from Wasu-ri to Dodeok-dong bus stop (Jamgok 3-ri) through villages near the DMZ, offering a glimpse of frontline life and lovely Hwagang River scenery.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 19코스
trails.ko: 복주산·복계산 깊은 임도를 따라 DMZ 접경 마을을 지나는 산길
trails.en: Goes from Dodeok-dong bus stop to Myeongwol 2-ri stop on forest roads deep into Bokjusan and Bokgyesan, via villages near the DMZ.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 19-1코스(우회로)
trails.ko: 와수리에서 복주산자연휴양림을 거쳐 명월2리까지, 체력이 필요한 긴 숲길
trails.en: A long detour from Wasu-ri via Bokjusan Recreational Forest to Myeongwol 2-ri stop through forest and villages; good stamina needed.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 20코스
trails.ko: 명월2리에서 산천어밸리까지, 험한 임도와 계곡 구간이 있는 길
trails.en: Runs from Myeongwol 2-ri stop to Sancheoneo Valley, including some tougher forest-road and stream-crossing sections.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 21코스
trails.ko: 마을길과 농로를 지나 북한강 산소길에서 붕어섬을 조망하는 쉬운 길
trails.en: Goes from Sancheoneo Valley to the Hwacheon Bridge roundabout on easy village lanes and farm roads. The Sansogil along the Bukhangang River looks out over Bungeoseom Island.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 22코스
trails.ko: 화천읍을 지나 딴산유원지·꺼먹다리·숲으로다리 등 북한강 절경을 즐기는 길
trails.en: Runs from the Hwacheon Bridge roundabout through Hwacheon town to Pungsangyo Bridge along the Bukhangang River, past Ttansan Resort, Kkeomeok Bridge and Supeuro Bridge.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 23코스
trails.ko: 평화누리자전거길 따라 평화의댐과 양의대습지 등 접경 풍경을 보는 길
trails.en: Goes from Pungsangyo Bridge to the International Peace Art Park at the Peace Dam, sharing the Peace Nuri bike path. Views of the Peace Dam, Yangeuidae Wetland and Andong Railway Bridge near the DMZ.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 24코스
trails.ko: 평화의댐·세계평화의종공원을 지나 양구 금악교까지, 험한 산세의 고난도 길
trails.en: A tough route from Hwacheon's International Peace Art Park to Geumakgyo Bridge in Yanggu, with rugged hills and long road stretches. Passes security-tourism sites such as the Peace Dam and World Peace Bell Park.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 25코스
trails.ko: 수입천변 탐방로를 따라 쾌적하게 걸어 두타연갤러리 거점센터에 이르는 길
trails.en: Goes from Jongjeom Store to Yanggu's Dutayeon Gallery on a pleasant trail along the Suipcheon Stream. The gallery houses a DMZ Peace Trail base centre.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 26코스 (예약노선)
trails.ko: 두타연의 청정 자연을 지나 피의능선 전투전적비까지, 예약이 필요한 민통선 길
trails.en: Runs from Dutayeon Gallery to the Bloody Ridge Battle Memorial through Dutayeon's pristine nature. Advance booking is required to enter the Civilian Control Zone.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 26-1코스(우회로)
trails.ko: 26코스 우회로로 두타연갤러리에서 피의능선 전투전적비까지 도로를 걷는 길
trails.en: A detour for Route 26 from Dutayeon Gallery to the Bloody Ridge Battle Memorial, largely along roads.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 30코스 (예약노선)
trails.ko: 인제 피스빌리지에서 백두대간을 넘어 대암산 용늪을 지나 진부령미술관까지
trails.en: Runs from Inje Peace Village to Jinburyeong Art Museum, crossing the Baekdudaegan mountain range. Passes pristine sites such as the Yongneup wetland on Daeamsan.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 31코스
trails.ko: 진부령미술관에서 수백 년 된 소나무 숲을 지나 고성 소똥령마을에 이르는 길
trails.en: Goes from Jinburyeong Art Museum in Inje to Sottongnyeong Village in Goseong through a forest of centuries-old pines. Connects with the DMZ Trail (Jeokgye-ro) and the Hyangnobong area.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 31-1코스(우회로)
trails.ko: 장날 소를 팔러 넘던 소똥령길을 따라 소똥령마을까지 가는 숲길
trails.en: A forest detour from Jinburyeong Art Museum to Sottongnyeong Village on the old ridge path once crossed to sell cattle on market days.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 32코스
trails.ko: 소똥령마을에서 백두대간 동쪽 농로와 숲길을 지나 금강산 건봉사까지
trails.en: Goes from Sottongnyeong Village to Geonbongsa Temple on Geumgangsan via quiet farm roads and forest east of the Baekdudaegan. The village offers farm activities and camping.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 32-1코스(우회로)
trails.ko: 소똥령마을에서 백두대간 숲길을 지나 동해 해안길 따라 거진항까지
trails.en: Runs from Sottongnyeong Village through quiet forest east of the Baekdudaegan to the East Sea coast at Geojin Port.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 33코스
trails.ko: 건봉사에서 백두대간을 넘어 동해안 통일안보공원까지, 누구나 걷기 쉬운 길
trails.en: An easy walk from Geonbongsa Temple over the Baekdudaegan to the East Sea coast and the Unification Security Park.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 33-1코스(우회로)
trails.ko: 거진항에서 산과 호수, 바다를 지나 통일안보공원에 이르는 고성 생태길
trails.en: Goes from Geojin Port to the Unification Security Park past mountains, lakes and sea, showcasing Goseong's natural and cultural sites.

trails.name: DMZ 평화의 길 34코스
trails.ko: DMZ 평화의 길·해파랑길의 마지막 구간, DMZ박물관을 지나 통일전망대까지
trails.en: The final leg of both the DMZ Peace Trail and the Haeparang-gil, from the Unification Security Park to the Unification Observatory. A security-tourism walk past the DMZ Museum and the East Sea coastal fences.

trails.name: 해파랑길 1코스
trails.ko: 오륙도 해맞이공원에서 광안리·해운대까지, 해식절벽과 번화한 해변을 잇는 첫 코스
trails.en: The first Haeparang-gil course, from Oryukdo Sunrise Park past Gwangalli Beach and the APEC beachfront to Haeundae. Sea cliffs and coastal scenery combine with lively Gwangalli and Haeundae.

trails.name: 해파랑길 4코스
trails.ko: 임랑해변에서 봉태산 숲길, 간절곶을 지나 진하해변까지 부산·울산 경계를 넘는 길
trails.en: Crosses from Gijang in Busan into Seosaeng-myeon, Ulju, from Imnang Beach via the Bongtaesan forest, Nasa Beach and Ganjeolgot Cape to Jinha Beach.

trails.name: 해파랑길 6코스
trails.ko: 덕하역에서 함월산을 올라 솔향 가득한 산길과 호숫가를 걸어 태화강전망대까지
trails.en: Goes from Deokha Station to the Taehwagang Observatory, mostly on hill trails starting with a climb up Hamwolsan, with pine-scented paths and a lakeside stroll.

trails.name: 해파랑길 7코스
trails.ko: 태화강전망대에서 십리대숲과 내황교를 지나 강을 따라 바다로 향하는 길
trails.en: Runs from the Taehwagang Observatory through the Simni Bamboo Forest and over Naehwanggyo Bridge to Yeompo junction, following the river toward the sea.

trails.name: 해파랑길 11코스
trails.ko: 나아해변에서 봉길대왕암해변·이견대를 지나 감포항까지, 역사 명승지를 잇는 길
trails.en: Links Yangnam-myeon and Gampo-eup in Gyeongju, from Naa Beach past Bonggil Daewangam Beach, Igyeondae and Jeonchon Port to Gampo Port. Note: Bonggil Tunnel early on is vehicles-only, so take a bus or car through it.

trails.name: 해파랑길 12코스
trails.ko: 감포항에서 송대말등대와 오류고아라해변을 지나 양포항까지, 어촌 정취 가득한 해안길
trails.en: Goes from Gampo Port past Songdaemal Lighthouse, Oryu Goara Beach and Yeondong Village to Yangpo Port, on coastal roads linking fishing villages and pretty harbours.

trails.name: 해파랑길 13코스
trails.ko: 양포항에서 구룡포항까지 해안을 따라 걸으며 싱싱한 회와 먹거리를 즐기는 길
trails.en: Goes from Yangpo Port to Guryongpo Port along the coast the whole way, with fine sea views and fresh raw fish at the harbours.

trails.name: 해파랑길 15코스
trails.ko: 해돋이 명소 호미곶에서 대보저수지·동호사를 거쳐 흥환보건소까지 가는 길
trails.en: Starts at Homigot, a famous sunrise spot with its lighthouse and museum, and passes Daebo Reservoir and Dongho Temple to Heunghwan Health Center.

trails.name: 해파랑길 16코스
trails.ko: 연오랑세오녀 테마공원과 도구해변, 포스코를 지나 송도해변에 이르는 길
trails.en: Goes from Heunghwan past Yeonorang Seonyeo Theme Park, Dogu Beach and the Hyeongsangang River to Songdo Beach, passing the POSCO steelworks where industry meets the East Sea.

trails.name: 해파랑길 17코스
trails.ko: 송도해변에서 칠포해변까지, 포스코를 조망하며 시원한 바다와 걷는 길
trails.en: Goes from Songdo Beach to Chilpo Beach, leaving industrial Pohang behind for the open sea, with views of POSCO, a symbol of Korea's industrialisation.

trails.name: 해파랑길 18코스
trails.ko: 칠포해변에서 화진해변까지 맑고 얕은 크고 작은 해변을 잇는 쉬운 길
trails.en: An easy walk from Chilpo Beach to Hwajin Beach along a series of clear, shallow beaches with long stretches of sand.

trails.name: 해파랑길 19코스(영덕 블루로드 1, 2코스)
trails.ko: 화진해변에서 장사·남호해변을 거쳐 강구항까지, 어촌 삶을 엿보는 블루로드
trails.en: Yeongdeok Blue Road sections 1–2, from Hwajin Beach via Jangsa and Namho beaches to Ganggu Port, through fishing villages.

trails.name: 해파랑길 20코스(영덕 블루로드 3코스)
trails.ko: 강구항에서 고불봉을 넘어 영덕해맞이공원까지, 풍력발전기와 바다 전망이 일품
trails.en: Yeongdeok Blue Road section 3, from Ganggu Port over Gobulbong Peak to Yeongdeok Haemaji Park, between mountains and sea. Wind turbines and ridge-top sea views are the highlight.

trails.name: 해파랑길 21코스(영덕 블루로드 4코스)
trails.ko: 해맞이공원에서 오보해변·대게탑을 지나 축산항까지 이어지는 조용한 해안길
trails.en: Yeongdeok Blue Road section 4, from Haemaji Park past Obo Beach and the Gyeongjeong-ri snow crab tower to Chuksan Port. A quiet walk of small forest paths and endless coastline.

trails.name: 해파랑길 23코스(영덕 블루로드 8코스)
trails.ko: 고래불해변에서 백석해변을 거쳐 후포항까지, 바다와 어촌을 지나는 조용한 길
trails.en: Yeongdeok Blue Road section 8, from Goraebul Beach via Baekseok Beach and Geumgokgyo Bridge to Hupo Port. A quiet seaside walk past fishing villages, with two rest areas on the way.

trails.name: 해파랑길 24코스
trails.ko: 후포항에서 등기산공원·월송정·대풍헌을 지나는 숲길·백사장·온천의 힐링 코스
trails.en: Goes from Hupo Port past Deunggisan Park, Wolsongjeong Pavilion and Daepungheon to Giseong Bus Terminal. A relaxing route of forest, tidal flats, sandy beaches and hot springs.

trails.name: 해파랑길 25코스
trails.ko: 망양휴게소와 망양정을 지나며 동해를 노래한 묵객들의 발자취를 따르는 길
trails.en: Goes from Giseong Bus Terminal past Mangyang Rest Area and Mangyangjeong Pavilion to Susangyo Bridge, in the footsteps of poets who wrote verses about the East Sea.

trails.name: 해파랑길 26코스
trails.ko: 울진엑스포공원·연호공원·봉평해변을 지나 죽변항까지, 볼거리 다채로운 길
trails.en: Runs past Uljin Expo Park, Yeonho Park and Bongpyeong Beach to the entrance of Jukbyeon Port, with parks, beaches, forest paths and a lighthouse.

trails.name: 해파랑길 27코스
trails.ko: 죽변등대와 옥계서원유허비각을 지나 어촌과 유적을 만나는 울진 최단 코스
trails.en: The shortest Uljin section, from Jukbyeon Port past Jukbyeon Lighthouse and the Okgye Seowon memorial site to Bugu junction, via fishing villages, historic sites and downtown Uljin.

trails.name: 해파랑길 28코스
trails.ko: 부구삼거리에서 도화동산·갈령재를 지나 호산까지, 내륙 위주지만 해안 절경이 빼어난 길
trails.en: Goes from Bugu junction via Dohwa Park and Gallyeongjae Pass to Hosan Bus Terminal. Mostly inland, but the coastal scenery on this course is superb.

trails.name: 해파랑길 30코스
trails.ko: 용화 레일바이크역에서 황영조기념공원을 지나 궁촌까지 바다를 보며 걷는 길
trails.en: Goes from Yonghwa Rail Bike Station past Hwang Young-cho Memorial Park to Gungchon Rail Bike Station, over low hills and beside the rail-bike line with sea views.

trails.name: 해파랑길 31코스
trails.ko: 궁촌에서 덕산해변까지 둑길과 마을, 해안로를 번갈아 걷는 어촌 풍경길
trails.en: Goes from Gungchon Rail Bike Station via Dongmakgyo and Bunamgyo bridges to Deoksan Beach, alternating roads, embankments, villages and coast.

trails.name: 해파랑길 33코스
trails.ko: 추암해변에서 한섬해변을 지나 묵호역까지, 해안절벽과 바위섬이 웅장한 길
trails.en: Goes from Chuam Beach via Donghae Station and Hanseom Beach to Mukho Station, with sea cliffs and rocky islets along well-kept seaside promenades.

trails.name: 해파랑길 39코스 바우길 05구간
trails.ko: 솔바람다리에서 허균·허난설헌 기념관과 경포대를 지나 사천진해변까지
trails.en: Goes from Solbaram Bridge past the Heo Gyun and Heo Nanseolheon memorial and Gyeongpodae Pavilion to Sacheonjin Beach, on pine forest, lakeside and coastal paths.

trails.name: 해파랑길 41코스
trails.ko: 주문진해변에서 남애항·광진해변을 지나 석호와 송림, 대숲을 걷는 해안길
trails.en: Goes from Jumunjin Beach past Namae Port and Gwangjin Beach to the entrance of Jukdojeong, via several harbours, lagoons, and pine and bamboo groves.

trails.name: 해파랑길 42코스
trails.ko: 죽도정에서 38선휴게소와 하조대를 지나 분단의 역사를 돌아보는 길
trails.en: Goes from Jukdojeong via the 38th Parallel Rest Area and Hajodae to Hajodae Beach, taking in Joseon-era Hajodae and the history of Korea's division.

trails.name: 해파랑길 44코스
trails.ko: 수산항에서 낙산해변과 낙산사를 지나 설악해맞이공원에 이르는 길
trails.en: Goes from Susan Port past Naksan Beach and Naksansa Temple to Seorak Haemaji Park, with views of the East Sea's famed Gwandong Palgyeong scenery.

trails.name: 해파랑길 45코스
trails.ko: 설악해맞이공원에서 아바이마을·속초등대를 지나 장사항까지 걷는 길
trails.en: Goes from Seorak Haemaji Park past Abai Village and Sokcho Lighthouse to Jangsa Port, with Seoraksan, the sea, lakes and fishing-village culture.

trails.name: 해파랑길 46코스
trails.ko: 장사항에서 청간정·천학정·능파대를 지나 삼포해변까지 송림과 절벽을 걷는 길
trails.en: Goes from Jangsa Port past the Cheonganjeong and Cheonhakjeong pavilions and Neungpadae to Sampo Beach, along coastal pine groves and cliffs.

trails.name: 해파랑길 47코스
trails.ko: 삼포해변에서 송지호 철새관망타워와 왕곡한옥마을을 지나 가진항까지
trails.en: Goes from Sampo Beach past the Songjiho Lake bird-watching tower and Wanggok Hanok Village to Gajin Port, with folk village, lakeside and coastal paths.

trails.name: 해파랑길 48코스
trails.ko: 가진항에서 북천철교를 지나 거진항까지, 바닷물과 민물이 만나는 생태를 보는 길
trails.en: Goes from Gajin Port over Namcheongyo Bridge and Bukcheon Railway Bridge to Geojin Port, where you can see fresh and salt water meet.

trails.name: 해파랑길 49코스
trails.ko: 거진항에서 김일성별장을 지나 통일전망대 출입신고소까지 산·호수·바다를 걷는 길
trails.en: Goes from Geojin Port past the Kim Il-sung Villa and Geumgangsan Condo to the Unification Observatory registration office, taking in mountains, lakes and sea.

trails.name: 해파랑길 50코스
trails.ko: 해파랑길 마지막 코스, 명파해변과 제진검문소를 지나 통일전망대까지(이후 차량 이동)
trails.en: The last Haeparang-gil course, through the DMZ area past Myeongpa Beach and Jejin Checkpoint to the Unification Observatory. Walking is allowed only as far as Jejin Checkpoint; the rest is by car.

trails.name: 해파랑길 2코스
trails.ko: 미포·청사포·구덕포 해운대 삼포를 거쳐 송정해변을 지나 대변항에 이르는 길
trails.en: Passes Haeundae's 'three ports' of Mipo, Cheongsapo and Gudeokpo, then Songjeong Beach, to reach Daebyeon Port.

trails.name: 해파랑길 34코스
trails.ko: 묵호역에서 묵호등대공원·망상해변을 지나 옥계시장까지 이어지는 길
trails.en: Goes from Mukho Station past Mukho Lighthouse Park and Mangsang Beach to Okgye Market, crossing from Donghae toward Gangneung via fishing villages and the Mangunsan valley.

trails.name: 해파랑길 35코스 바우길 09구간
trails.ko: 옥계시장에서 금진항·심곡항을 지나 정동진역까지, 바다와 숲길이 어우러진 길
trails.en: Gangneung Baugil section 9, from Okgye Market past Okgye Beach and Geumjin and Simgok ports to Jeongdongjin Station, on open coast and forest paths.

trails.name: 해파랑길 40코스 바우길 12구간
trails.ko: 사천진해변에서 연곡해변·주문진항을 지나 어시장과 등대, 백사장을 거니는 길
trails.en: Goes from Sacheonjin Beach past Yeongok Beach and Jumunjin Port to Jumunjin Beach, a classic coastal walk with a fish market, lighthouse and sandy beaches.
